# Messaging platforms

The platforms the messaging gateway can run, from its registry.

Set a platform's credential (in `.env`, the keychain or through `indus gateway setup`) and enable it; `indus gateway run` starts every enabled platform. Per-platform policy variables are listed in [Environment variables](environment-variables.md#messaging-platforms).

| Name | Platform | Credential | Longest message | Install |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `telegram` | Telegram | `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` | 4096 | pip install indus-agent (Telegram needs no extra) |
| `discord` | Discord | `DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN` | 2000 | pip install 'indus-agent[discord]' |
| `slack` | Slack | `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN`, `SLACK_APP_TOKEN` | 39000 | pip install 'indus-agent[slack]' |
| `signal` | Signal | `SIGNAL_HTTP_URL`, `SIGNAL_ACCOUNT` | 8000 | install signal-cli and run `signal-cli --account <number> daemon --http 127.0.0.1:8080` (no Python extra) |
| `matrix` | Matrix | `MATRIX_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `MATRIX_HOMESERVER` | 15000 | pip install indus-agent (Matrix needs no extra; end-to-end encryption: pip install 'indus-agent[matrix-e2ee]' on Linux) |
| `mattermost` | Mattermost | `MATTERMOST_TOKEN`, `MATTERMOST_URL` | 4000 | pip install 'indus-agent[mattermost]' |
| `email` | Email | `EMAIL_ADDRESS`, `EMAIL_PASSWORD`, `EMAIL_IMAP_HOST`, `EMAIL_SMTP_HOST` | 50000 | pip install indus-agent (email needs no extra) |
| `whatsapp` | WhatsApp | — | 4096 | install Node.js 24 and a WhatsApp Web provider module (exports createWaSocket; platforms.whatsapp.provider), then set platforms.whatsapp.enabled: true |
| `whatsapp_cloud` | WhatsApp Business (Cloud API) | `WHATSAPP_CLOUD_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `WHATSAPP_CLOUD_PHONE_NUMBER_ID` | 4096 | pip install indus-agent (WhatsApp Cloud needs no extra) |
| `sms` | SMS (Twilio) | `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID`, `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN`, `TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER` | 1600 | pip install indus-agent (SMS needs no extra) |
| `line` | LINE | `LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET` | 20000 | pip install indus-agent (LINE needs no extra) |
| `ntfy` | ntfy | `NTFY_TOPIC` | 4096 | pip install indus-agent (ntfy needs no extra) |
| `irc` | IRC | `IRC_SERVER`, `IRC_NICKNAME` | 450 | pip install indus-agent (IRC needs no extra) |
| `teams` | Microsoft Teams | `TEAMS_CLIENT_ID`, `TEAMS_CLIENT_SECRET`, `TEAMS_TENANT_ID` | 28000 | pip install indus-agent (Teams needs no extra) |
| `google_chat` | Google Chat | `GOOGLE_CHAT_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON` | 4000 | pip install 'indus-agent[google-chat]' |
| `qqbot` | QQ Bot | `QQ_APP_ID`, `QQ_CLIENT_SECRET` | 4000 | pip install 'indus-agent[qqbot]' |
| `dingtalk` | DingTalk | `DINGTALK_CLIENT_ID`, `DINGTALK_CLIENT_SECRET` | 20000 | pip install 'indus-agent[dingtalk]' |
| `wecom` | WeCom | `WECOM_BOT_ID`, `WECOM_SECRET` | 4000 | pip install 'indus-agent[wecom]' |
| `wecom_callback` | WeCom (callback app) | `WECOM_CALLBACK_CORP_ID`, `WECOM_CALLBACK_CORP_SECRET`, `WECOM_CALLBACK_AGENT_ID`, `WECOM_CALLBACK_TOKEN`, `WECOM_CALLBACK_ENCODING_AES_KEY` | 2048 | pip install 'indus-agent[wecom]' |
| `weixin` | Weixin / WeChat | `WEIXIN_TOKEN`, `WEIXIN_ACCOUNT_ID` | 2000 | pip install 'indus-agent[weixin]' |
| `feishu` | Feishu / Lark | `FEISHU_APP_ID`, `FEISHU_APP_SECRET` | 8000 | pip install 'indus-agent[feishu]' (the long connection; webhook mode and sending need no extra) |
| `bluebubbles` | BlueBubbles (iMessage) | `BLUEBUBBLES_SERVER_URL`, `BLUEBUBBLES_PASSWORD` | 4000 | pip install indus-agent (BlueBubbles needs no extra); run BlueBubbles Server on a Mac |
| `photon` | iMessage (Photon) | `PHOTON_PROJECT_ID`, `PHOTON_PROJECT_SECRET` | 8000 | install Node.js 24 and a Photon Spectrum provider module (exports createSpectrumLink; platforms.photon.provider), then set platforms.photon.enabled: true |
| `simplex` | SimpleX Chat | `SIMPLEX_WS_URL` | 8000 | pip install 'indus-agent[simplex]' and run `simplex-chat -p 5225` |
| `buzz` | Buzz | `BUZZ_RELAY_URL`, `BUZZ_PRIVATE_KEY` | 16000 | pip install 'indus-agent[buzz]' |
| `yuanbao` | Yuanbao | `YUANBAO_APP_ID`, `YUANBAO_APP_SECRET` | 4000 | pip install 'indus-agent[yuanbao]' |
| `raft` | Raft | `RAFT_PROFILE` | — | pip install indus-agent (Raft needs no extra); install the Raft CLI and run `raft agent bridge` against the URL in <profile home>/platforms/raft/bridge.json |
| `api_server` | API server | — | — | pip install 'indus-agent[gateway]' |
| `webhook` | Webhook receiver | — | — | pip install 'indus-agent[gateway]' |
| `msgraph` | Microsoft Graph change notifications | `MSGRAPH_WEBHOOK_CLIENT_STATE` | — | pip install indus-agent (no extra) |
| `a2a` | A2A (Agent2Agent) | — | 1000000 | pip install indus-agent (A2A needs no extra); set platforms.a2a.enabled: true |
